name: County Line Veterinary Hospital
address: 325 West County Line Road, Hatboro, PA 19040
hours: Mon to Fri 9 am to 8 pm. Sat 9 am to 1 pm. Closed Sun.
description: Since 1956, County Line Veterinary Hospital in Hatboro has provided pet owners of Montgomery and Bucks Counties with compassionate, high-quality care within a state-of-the-art, full-service veterinary hospital.
tagline: Professional pet care with a personal touch

hero.headline: Professional pet care with a personal touch
hero.sub: Since 1956, compassionate, high-quality care for the pets of Montgomery and Bucks Counties in a state-of-the-art, full-service veterinary hospital.

offerings.heading: Hospital care, <mark>every stage.</mark>
items: Wellness exams, vaccinations, and preventive care
Diagnostics, surgery, and dentistry inside a full-service hospital
Weekday hours until 8 pm and an online pharmacy
Serving Montgomery and Bucks Counties since 1956

story.heading: A hospital, not just a clinic
paragraphs: County Line Veterinary Hospital has treated the pets of Hatboro since 1956, a full-service hospital with the doctors and staff to match.
Take a look around, meet the doctors and staff, and call to set up an appointment.

experience.heading: Visiting the hospital
items: Call (215) 675-0533; weekday hours run until 8 pm.
Tour the hospital online, then meet the veterinarians.
Refill through the online pharmacy between visits.

feature.heading: Urgent care services coming in 2026
feature.text: The hospital is adding urgent care, so the team that knows your pet is there when it cannot wait for Monday.

closing.heading: Professional pet care with a personal touch, since 1956
